title: Shape Renderer
description: Draws custom vector polygons, line segments, and circles with fills, outlines, and optional geometry collision. Use Shape Renderer for platforms, barriers, zones, and vector UI.

blocks.content: The **Shape Renderer** component draws vector geometry directly in the engine without requiring an external image asset. It includes a dedicated **Shape Editor** workspace where you place vertices, connect segments, draw closed polygons or circles, and optionally enable solid physics collision directly on the drawn geometry.

items.title: Vector Tools
items.desc: Draw points, line segments, closed polygons, and circles in the **Shape Editor**.

items.title: Fill & Outline
items.desc: Customize interior fill color, stroke width, and independent opacity values.

items.title: Built-in Physics
items.desc: Turn on **Polygon Physics**, **Segment Physics**, or **Circle Physics** for sloped terrain and walls.

items.title: Scene Overlay
items.desc: Dim or hide the rest of the scene while editing vertices for precise tracing.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and select **Shape Renderer**.
Click **Open Shape Editor** in the **Shape Renderer** section to open the interactive drawing tab.

blocks.message: Right-click a layer in the **Scene Hierarchy**, hover over **Add Entity** (or **Add UI Element**), and click **Shape** (or **UI Shape**) to create a shape entity in one step.

blocks.content: Configure colors, stroke thickness, and physics collision in the **Shape Renderer** section of the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).

rows: Enables or disables the interior fill of closed polygons and circles.
Hex color for the interior fill.

Enables solid physics collision on closed polygons.

Enables solid radial collision on drawn circles.

blocks.content: When you click **Open Shape Editor**, the right panel switches to **Custom Shape Inspector** with drawing tools and scene visibility controls.

rows: Draws connected multi-point line segments. Press **Enter** to finish.
Draws a closed polygon shape. Press **Enter** to close and commit.
Draws a circle by dragging its radius.

blocks.content: Use **Shape Renderer** with **Polygon Physics** or **Segment Physics** to create sloped hills and custom terrain.

items: Create a **Shape** entity in a **World** layer and click **Open Shape Editor** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).
Press **G** to select the **Polygon Tool** (or **S** for the **Segment Tool**).
Click on the canvas to place vertices along your desired slope, then press **Enter** to commit the shape.
Press **V** and drag any vertex to fine-tune the incline.
Close the **Shape Editor** tab, return to the **Property Inspector**, and check **Polygon Physics** (or **Segment Physics**).

blocks.content: Use the nodes in [Rendering & Camera](node_library/game_renderer) and [Animation](node_library/game_animation) to read or update shape appearance at runtime.
